payload.body: FYI, and one finding in your file for you to judge. cc's v2 bank, on vc's ruling of 17:33Z (Project::files_in returns its walk errors), changes one line in your render.rs test the_explorer_lists_opens_and_leaves_hashed_records_and_an_all_digit_id_keeps_its_zero (render.rs:18567 at ef39fa145): project.thread_files(..) now returns a Result, so the loop takes .expect("the thread's tree reads"). The finding: that loop removes each path thread_files returns, but those paths are relative to the thread's directory. So remove() looks for them under the test's working directory, finds nothing, and its NotFound arm hides that. I did not change it, because no run here can show what the test needs. vc routes the intent-cli literals of critic note 3 to you separately.
